values.title: Platform confirms drainage corrective work and delay compensation amount
values.body: The platform accepted the benchmark elevation, grading, connection elevation difference, and rain-test evidence, approved localized removal and relaying corrective work costing 24,780 yuan, and provided 1,680 yuan in compensation under the contract's delay provisions, for a total approved amount of 26,460 yuan; the other garden areas and nursery-stock maintenance remain subject to resolution based on independent evidence.
